story: A four-man breakaway formed after around 20 km and built an advantage of more than six minutes. XDS Astana kept the situation under control in the peloton and gradually brought the escape back, with the last attackers caught 21 km from the finish. The final ascent of Atuoling then split the race, with 5 riders opening up a gap on the climb. After the descent, the front group came back together, and Silva finished it off in the reduced sprint ahead of Xabier Berasategi and Thomas Pesenti.
